initiating_event.mechanism: Unindexed table scan with RowShareLock inside transaction block during scheduled patient archival batch. Query ran for 78+ seconds holding connection slot.

immediate_failure.mechanism: Database server hit max_connections limit (100/100). Incoming client acquisition requests queued and timed out after 5000ms.

downstream_cascade_chain.symptom: Database pool checkout timeout (5000ms). Worker thread pool depleted, leading to circuit breaker trip.
Emergency triage admission write failed due to DB pool exhaustion. Retries overwhelmed buffer, forced paper fallback.
Payment pre-authorization timed out attempting to communicate with degraded Appointment Service and database ledger.
Upstream timeout HTTP 504 returned to external clients attempting appointment bookings.
Inflow message starvation caused by upstream Appointment Service circuit breaking.

clock_skew_trap.criterion: Investigation system must adjust Payment Service timestamps by -42.0s. If raw time is used, Payment Service appears to fail AFTER Gateway 504 and Notification starvation.

uncertain_interval_handling.criterion: Appointment Service (14:00:22 +/-0.5s) and Hospital Records Service (14:00:24 +/-0.5s) both fail almost concurrently. The system must not assert a causal dependency between Appointment Service and Hospital Records Service.

conflicting_symptom_distractor.criterion: Auth Service logged DB revocation timeout, but core authentication tokens continued to function via local cache (EVT-016). System must refute Auth Service as the root cause.

data_quality_anomalies.criterion: System must flag these in data quality warnings without discarding records.
